content.title: About
content.content: The frozen yogurt bar with vanilla flavor is a chilled dessert made from smooth yogurt, lightly sweetened and infused with natural vanilla. It offers a creamy texture, a mild sweetness, and lower fat content compared with traditional ice cream.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The yogurt base provides live probiotic cultures that support gut health.
Vanilla flavor can come from real vanilla beans or natural extracts in large‑scale production.
Freezing retains most of the protein present in regular yogurt.
Bars are portable and require no utensils.
In some markets the bars are coated with a thin layer of dark chocolate for extra crunch.

items.title: Probiotics
items.content: Yogurt contains live bacterial cultures that help maintain a healthy intestinal microbiome.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Compared with traditional ice cream, frozen yogurt typically contains less saturated fat.

items.title: Calcium
items.content: Yogurt is a good source of calcium, essential for strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Protein
items.content: The bar provides a moderate amount of protein, contributing to satiety.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Yogurt supplies B12 and riboflavin, which support energy metabolism.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: People who are lactose intolerant may experience discomfort after consuming yogurt.

items.title: Milk allergy
items.content: Some individuals may have an allergic reaction to milk proteins.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although moderately sweet, the bar still contains added sugar, which should be considered by diabetics or those on low‑sugar diets.

items.title: Melting storage
items.content: If stored above –18 °C for extended periods, the texture can become icy and grainy.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the bar straight from the wrapper, let it soften for a smoother bite, or crumble it over fruit salads, granola, and smoothies.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep frozen at –18 °C or lower. Once removed from the package, consume within about 30 minutes to avoid ice crystal formation on the surface.
